_description: Label-aware node types (ADR-021). Cluster A1 asks for three kinds of routable workers on one shared pool: 3 machines of dedicated=AAA workers, 3 of dedicated=BBB workers and 3 plain workers, all cut in thirds. With config.auto_group_labels=["dedicated"] each kind is its own anti-affinity / max-per-BM group (spread over the 3 AGs independently) and its own footprint (C7) row; the placement matrix shows three rows for A1/worker and hostnames carry the label value (worker-R-AAA-01). Untick dedicated in the Policy card to merge them into one group.
